purpose: Analysis of a shared research artifact by an AI service.
claim: A human shares a research artifact with an AI service under conditions that are declared, limited to analysis, explicitly consented to, and reversible through deletion.
unknowns: Nature or content of the research artifact.
Mechanism by which the transfer is declared.
Mechanism by which consent is captured.
Mechanism by which deletion is effected.
Whether deletion fully reverses all derived state (e.g., model influence, cached copies).
authority: The human (originator of the artifact and consent-giver).
affected_parties: Any third parties whose data may be embedded in the artifact (not specified).
provenance: Source statement describing the exchange; no external evidence cited.
consequences: AI service gains access to the research artifact for analysis.
Human retains the right to reverse the transfer through deletion.
consequence_horizon: Unspecified; bounded by the analysis use and the reversibility condition.
recovery: Deletion of the artifact by the AI service (or at the human's request) restores the pre-transfer state, subject to the unknowns above.
confidence: Low-to-moderate: the source statement asserts the conditions but provides no operational detail or verification.
notes: The source statement is a normative description of an exchange rather than a report of an observed event. No evidence, dissent, or concrete authority beyond the two participants is supplied. Unknowns are preserved rather than resolved.
